name: Turnover counted in any preceding financial year from 2017-18

attrs.quote: for the words ―a financial year‖, the words and figures ―any preceding financial year from 2017-18 onwards‖ shall be substituted
attrs.scope: registered persons, for the threshold in notification 13/2020
attrs.note: Published 30 September 2020 with no date of its own; it amends notification 13/2020, which came into force on 1 October 2020.
